error.title: Could not add recipe

error.unsupportedMessage: idkjustfood reads Instagram reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts and recipe websites. You can still paste the recipe text or add a screenshot.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while reading the recipe. Try again, or paste the recipe text instead.

errors.unsupported_link: This link is not supported yet. Paste the recipe text or add a screenshot instead.

errors.invalid_input: There was nothing to read. Check the link, text or photo and try again.

errors.model_cannot_read_images: The AI model that is set up cannot read photos. Try a link or the recipe text instead.
errors.ai_failed: The AI could not turn this into a recipe. Try again in a moment.
errors.video_unavailable: The video could not be downloaded. It may be private or removed.
errors.video_too_long: This video is too long to read.
errors.tools_missing: The tools needed to read videos are missing on this server.
errors.page_unreachable: The page could not be opened. Check the link and try again.
errors.no_recipe_found: No recipe was found. Try pasting the recipe text or adding a screenshot.
errors.invalid_recipe: What was found did not make a complete recipe. Try pasting the recipe text instead.
